summary: No advisory committee was convened for NDA208945 (XEPI, ozenoxacin cream 1% for impetigo). The Summary Review states the NDA was not discussed at an advisory committee meeting because there were no specific questions or issues needing committee input, and the Medical Review similarly notes an AC was not convened as no issues arose during review that would benefit from AC discussion. Consequently there are no AdCom-driven linkages to any approval changes.
